reason: ItemAttention achieved macro validation HR@10=0.3825 versus SASRec’s 0.505, declining in every category; its independently embedded history items lack contextual sequence information, although training differences prevent assigning the entire gap to this limitation. Historical experiments motivate retaining candidate-conditioned pooling and normalized scoring while testing a compact Transformer encoder. Modify model_design for contextualization and training_evaluation for matching checkpoint reconstruction, keeping data processing and the existing training protocol fixed.

plan.model_design: Extend ItemAttention with learned positional embeddings and two causal Transformer blocks using 96 hidden units, two attention heads, and dropout 0.2, contextualizing history before candidate-conditioned key projection and value pooling. This tests whether preceding purchases and interaction order improve the compatibility model while retaining the historically motivated candidate attention mechanism rather than replacing it with masked-item reconstruction. Add positions to history embeddings, apply residual attention and feed-forward layers with layer normalization, then normalize contextual history representations for the existing history_key projection and pooled values; retain target_query, normalized candidate scoring, learned scales, recency_raw, and jointly trained item_bias. Mask padding in both contextualization and candidate pooling, explicitly prevent fully masked attention rows from producing NaNs on left-padded sequences, and zero padded outputs after each block. Preserve ItemAttention, forward(self, seq, candidates), predict(self, seq, candidates), existing parameter names, and constructor arguments, adding only optional architecture configuration arguments.
plan.training_evaluation: Update train_category, save_checkpoint, and write_predict_script so config records the contextual encoder dimensions, block count, head count, and dropout, and working/predict.py reconstructs ItemAttention from that config and strictly loads its state_dict. Preserve existing function signatures, category routing, checkpoint filenames, and exactly one independently trained network with one selected checkpoint per category; validation and hosted inference must call the same model.predict implementation. Keep PrefixDataset training-only prefix sampling, 127 uniform negatives, cross-entropy, embedding penalty, AdamW settings, batch size, MAXLEN, validation frequency, time limits, and early stopping unchanged to isolate the history encoder change. Retain preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, supplied splits, all four categories, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and SASREC_EPOCHS with host default 200. Preserve validation with seed 42, 200 users per category, 99 unique negative candidates, HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking, and macro-average reporting; treat an absolute gain of 0.03 over 0.3825 as an experimental hypothesis, with no hidden-test access or evaluator changes.
